title: Al-Muhadhdhab fi Fiqh al-Imam al-Shafi'i
author: abu-ishaq-al-shirazi
attributionNote: The attribution is the one the manuscript tradition and the scholarship give.
description: A full statement of Shafi'i law with the evidence for each ruling drawn from the Qur'an, hadith and analogy. Al-Nawawi's al-Majmu', the largest Shafi'i reference work, was written as a commentary on it.
historicalContext: Abu Ishaq al-Shirazi was the first professor of the Nizamiyya college in Baghdad, founded for him by Nizam al-Mulk. Al-Muhadhdhab and its shorter companion al-Tanbih became the core of the Shafi'i curriculum.
availabilityNote: Arabic text only, streamed from OpenITI at read time. No English translation is included because no public-domain English translation was verified. Only the catalogue record, chapter outline and passage index are held here.
